Thanks again for taking the time this morning for the discovery. Quick recap: we covered integration patterns, data flow requirements, and the top three latency/cost constraints you mentioned. I left a short set of notes attached (discovery-notes-20261022.pdf) and a skeleton Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align owners.

Observations / open items:
- Ops lead didn’t join (I got a last-minute calendar conflict from Adam) — we flagged a couple of infra questions that are blockers for a technical deep-dive.
- Product team wants a 30m walk-through focused on our prefix caching and routing policies; Ops wants a separate 20m ops-focused runbook.

Next steps I propose: either
1) a single 45m technical + ops session (engineer + ops on your side) OR
2) two short sessions (30m technical demo; 20m ops runbook) — option 2 is usually faster to schedule.

Please confirm which approach you prefer and who should represent Ops. If Adam still can’t attend, happy to run the ops run-through with Evan + our Solutions Engineer Ben. I’ve pinned two tight windows below that we can hold for 24 hours: please confirm by EOD Thursday 10/22 PT or we’ll release the slots.

- Tuesday 10/27 10:00–10:30 (30m) + optional 10:35–10:55 (20m ops)
- Wednesday 10/28 09:00–09:30 (30m) + optional 09:35–09:55 (20m ops)
